title: Coverage Before Control: Route-Instruction Grounding and Steering for Controllable Retrosynthesis
abstract: arXiv:2609.39955v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Single-step retrosynthesis models are commonly evaluated by their ability to recover recorded reactions. In practice, chemists may need to choose among several precursor sets for the same product, for example to preserve a particular motif. Recovering a recorded answer alone does not establish this ability to follow a preference. Satisfying such requests requires both coverage of relevant alternatives and control over which alternatives are favored. We introduce Route-Instruction Grounding and Steering (RIGS), a two-stage framework for instruction-conditioned retrosynthesis. Stage A trains a language projector, teaching it which alternatives an instruction favors or discourages. Stage B uses the projector learned in Stage A to steer a frozen generative model through lightweight residual adapters. translated_title: 先覆盖后控制：用于可控逆合成的路线指令接地与转向
translated_abstract: 单步逆合成模型通常通过其恢复已记录反应的能力来评估。在实践中，化学家可能需要在同一产物的多个前体集合中进行选择，例如为了保留特定的分子结构基团。仅恢复已记录的答案并不能证明模型具备遵循这种偏好的能力。满足此类请求既需要对相关替代方案的覆盖，也需要控制哪些替代方案被优先采纳。我们提出了路线指令接地与转向（Route-Instruction Grounding and Steering, RIGS），这是一个面向指令条件化逆合成的两阶段框架。阶段A训练一个语言投影器，教会它识别指令偏好或不鼓励哪些前体替代方案。阶段B利用阶段A学到的投影器，通过轻量级残差适配器来引导一个冻结的生成模型。我们通过将每个产物与数量递增的候选前体集合配对，构建了嵌套的一对多训练支持集。大量实验……
tldr: 提出了RIGS两阶段框架，通过语言投影器学习指令所偏好的前体方案，并利用轻量级残差适配器引导冻结的生成模型，实现了可控的指令条件化逆合成。
en_tdlr: RIGS, a two-stage framework that trains a language projector to learn which precursor alternatives an instruction favors, then steers a frozen generative model via lightweight residual adapters, enabling controllable instruction-conditioned retrosynthesis.
